scope: Frozen primary-source identity and exact append observations, not legal/runtime qualification
edpb_title: Guidelines01/2022 right of access, Version2.1 adopted28March2023

source_assessment.intake: EDPB53-57/159 accepts other provided appropriate official channels, internal forwarding cannot reset receipt, staff awareness is unnecessary; proposal preserves this.
source_assessment.verification: EDPB58-79 supports record identification plus proportionate authentication, reasonable-doubt additional information, minimization, existing credentials/verified contacts, no default ID copies; changed contacts and historical/process scope remain separately assessed.
source_assessment.representatives: EDPB80-81 requires suitable verification of representative identity and authority with applicable national-law qualification; proposal leaves exact procedure/qualification held.
source_assessment.deadlines: GDPR12(3)-(4), EDPB157-164 require undue-delay response and calendar month with exceptional justified up-to-two-further-month extension notified in initial month. EDPB159 allows narrowly justified suspension,160-161 calendar/month-end/working-day rules. Proposed original-clock default is conservative, not a legal prohibition or automatic verified completion.
source_assessment.third_party_limit: GDPR15(4), EDPB172-173/example35 require concrete adverse-impact assessment and balancing; mixed subject/staff data can sometimes be disclosed. Categorical exclusion at SECURITY956 conflicts despite subsequent justified-redaction/no-whole-refusal language.
source_assessment.operation: D070/D076/entity contact preserve approved alias and undecided owner; original IFPRIVACY01/02/DE20 remain deletion-only. Rights response, unknown provider deletion, scoped grants, purpose/copy binding and ephemeral data limits remain separate.

limits: Only saved supplied sources read; source host/fetch assertions retained from producer records, no new network identity check. National-law, secure mailbox/delivery, actual grants/storage, legal bases/durations and integrated/founder acceptance unqualified.
